Dear Sir/Madam,   
 
Ref: Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 
 
Subject: Intimation for Receipt of an order of about INR 7.6 Crores  
 
We are pleased to inform you that our Company, Diffusion Engineers Limited has received a 
Domestic order worth about INR 7.6 Crores for Supply of Rollers for Cement Mill Roller Press to be 
delivered over a period of next 10 months. 
 
Disclosure as required under SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated November 
11, 2024 is annexed as Annexure-1. 
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Thanking You,  
 
For Diffusion Engineers Limited
